audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Swain 6 of 7 stages including the two-item row, against a 55.08% Vayne win rate over 728 games; and diff read FAV while every row said otherwise.
audit.why: Swain owns the middle of the lane on range and sustain, but Level 1 is a one-spell stage he cannot dominate, and two items of percent-max-health true damage beats a health-stacking drain tank. The already-audited Swain side flipped exactly these two rows.
audit.corrected: Skill, Swain, Swain, Skill, Swain, Skill, Vayne, with diff EVEN — proposed as matched full/content pairs with ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written around a misnamed ultimate and never said what actually changes at two items.
audit.why: Demonic Ascension is a flat 120s and sustains as long as he keeps draining champions, so his 6 is a sustain spike, not a burst one. Vayne's answering spike is two items of Silver Bolts, whose percent-max-health true damage scales with the health he stacks off Soul Fragments.
audit.corrected: His 6 is sustain on 120s; your two-item Silver Bolts out-race it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four lines call Vision of Empire a 'snare' — it is a slow that reveals. The root and the pull are both Nevermove (E). The ultimate is written as 'Dragonic Ascension'. And nothing records that Vision of Empire reveals stealth.
audit.why: Riot's text: Vision of Empire 'deals damage and slows enemies. Champions hit are revealed'; Nevermove 'roots enemies it hits. Swain can then choose to pull all rooted champions closer'. Vayne's only stealth is Final Hour's Tumble invisibility, so a 22s-cooldown reveal from up to 7500 units strips the escape half of her ultimate. Ravenous Flock heals him off minion kills, which is what makes Grievous Wounds timing decide long trades.
audit.corrected: Vision of Empire slows and reveals — it lights up your Final Hour Tumbles; the root-pull is Nevermove on 12s.

edits.before: Swain out-ranges and out-sustains you badly here — his W snare and E root-pull chunk you from afar and his passive heals off minions, so play far back and only step up for CS after his E is on cooldown.
edits.after: Swain out-ranges and out-sustains you here — Vision of Empire slows and reveals you from across the map, Nevermove roots then pulls on 12s, and Ravenous Flock heals him off minions. Step up only once his E is spent.

edits.after: Demonic Ascension is a health and sustain spike on 120s; if he Nevermoves you and pops R he wins the all-in outright. And Vision of Empire reveals — it lights up your Final Hour Tumbles, so stealth is not the escape here.

edits.after: Through 3-6 Nevermove's root-pull and Ascension's drain beat you in any long fight; buy Grievous Wounds before you commit, stay clear of Vision of Empire, and scale on CS.

notes: suspectNames was right: 'Dragonic Ascension' is fixed to Demonic Ascension. The bigger find is that Vision of Empire reveals stealth over 5500-7500 units on a 22s cooldown, which strips Final Hour's Tumble invisibility — that appeared nowhere in either layer. Several dosFull/tradeGood strings refer to Vayne as 'his'; cosmetic and left alone.
